title: BTC War live market snapshot
description: Validation contract for BTC War's sourced, timestamped Binance Spot snapshot of nine USDT markets.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this BTC War market snapshot contract.

schema.description: Canonical JSON Schema URI that validates this response.

id.description: Stable identifier and live URL of the ordinary JSON snapshot.

canonicalPage.description: Canonical human-readable page associated with this machine response.

about.description: Identity of the publisher, disambiguated from similarly named tokens or geopolitical commentary.

description.description: Plain-language identity statement for entity disambiguation.

methodology.description: How the venue observations, timestamps and rolling window were obtained.

generatedAt.description: UTC time when BTC War generated this exact response.

source.description: Provenance for every market observation in this response.

venue.description: Single trading venue represented by this snapshot.

marketType.description: Market type; these values are spot-market observations, not derivatives.

endpoint.description: Upstream Binance market-data endpoint used for the observations.

documentation.description: Official Binance documentation for the upstream rolling 24-hour ticker.

dataSource.description: Binance dataSource value for the upstream endpoint.

window.description: Statistical time window used by Binance for change, high, low, volume and trade-count fields.

type.description: The 24-hour interval advances continuously rather than following a calendar day.

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration for the rolling 24-hour interval.

maxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum intended edge age of a successful snapshot, in seconds.

markets.description: Exactly nine complete, fresh Binance Spot USDT market observations.

limitations.description: Scope and interpretation limits, including single-venue coverage and non-advisory use.

decimal.description: Signed decimal encoded as a string so clients can preserve source precision.
decimal.$comment: Decimal values remain strings so clients can preserve the source precision.

unsignedDecimal.description: Non-negative decimal encoded as a string so clients can preserve source precision.

market.description: One fresh, sourced Binance Spot rolling 24-hour ticker observation.

symbol.description: Binance Spot symbol for this observation.

baseAsset.description: Base asset whose quantity is measured by baseVolume.

quoteAsset.description: Quote asset used for prices, priceChange and quoteVolume.

lastPrice.description: Most recent Binance Spot trade price, expressed as USDT per one base asset.

priceChange.description: Absolute price change over the rolling 24-hour window, expressed in USDT.

priceChangePercent.description: Relative price change over the rolling 24-hour window, expressed as a percentage; for example, 1.307 means 1.307%, not 0.01307%.

highPrice.description: Highest trade price in the rolling 24-hour window, expressed in USDT.

lowPrice.description: Lowest trade price in the rolling 24-hour window, expressed in USDT.

baseVolume.description: Executed volume in units of the base asset during the rolling 24-hour window.

quoteVolume.description: Executed notional volume in USDT during the rolling 24-hour window.

tradeCount.description: Number of Binance Spot trades counted in the rolling 24-hour window.

windowOpenAt.description: UTC opening time of the rolling 24-hour statistics window.

sourceObservedAt.description: UTC Binance closeTime for this market observation.

sourceLagSeconds.description: Whole seconds between generatedAt and sourceObservedAt.

status.description: BTC War fails closed instead of publishing a stale market item.
